result:
The world feels so static, so studied and muted, a scene in which I feel out of my depth. The hairs on my neck stand up when I step out the door, a sensation akin to exhilaration mixed with a wash of dread. I'm going a little bit crazy just by exploring this new world before me, the rise of a completely unknown sky beckoning me upwards. New things seem to appear in a burst right before my eyes, flashes of bright, unexpected surprise, like a succession of memes, good old-fashioned comics, post-it notes scribbled with urgency. I'm soon overwhelmed, a swell of passion rises up from within, a sudden explosion of newfound feeling, and before I know it I'm wrecked. It's like a child running around and suddenly stopping suddenly to look up into the night sky, eyes wide in amazement. Today I cakes are for us to do as we please. 

There's a forever checklist turning itself in my mind and heart, so many manifesto priorities for starting again. Follow learning something new, something it's been ages since you learned before. Truth is, in your mind there is so wide an array of things unseeable that the real thing starts capturing your core. Each stutter, or pause to continue to ever increasing simplicity, bringing new blooms with loving care to what was barren and overgrown last time. The lists in my head abounded with cliches and art and systems of the world. I buoy myself watching the sky change, knowing all of this has come and is yet to go.
